name: ChangeConfirmationModal
description: Generic confirmation modal that shows a diff or summary of pending changes before applying them

props.name: open
props.description: Controls whether the dialog is visible

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Called when the user clicks the confirm button

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when the user cancels or dismisses the dialog

props.name: children
props.description: Body content — use to describe the change being confirmed

props.name: destructive
props.description: When `true`, the confirm button uses the danger variant
